description_en: Update the real-time packaging origin endpoint configuration of a channel group, supporting protocol, time-shift settings, and access control
description_zh: 更新频道组的实时打包源站端点配置，支持协议、时移设置及访问控制
kebab_example: aliyun ice update-live-package-origin-endpoint --group-name channel-group-1 --channel-name channel-1 --endpoint-name endpoint-1 --protocol HLS --manifest-name manifest --description This_is_an_origin_endpoint. --timeshift-vision 5 --authorization-code Abc123Def456 --ip-whitelist 192.168.1.0/24,10.0.0.1 --ip-blacklist 103.0.0.0/8 --live-packaging-config example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLivePackageOriginEndpoint

parameters.description_en: The origin endpoint name. It can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length. Format: \[A-Za-z0-9\_-]+
